description: Make one audio file per text from a list, in one call: vocabulary and flashcards, quiz questions and answers, H5P and other e-learning clips, app or game lines, each line of a dialogue as its own file. Up to 50 texts of up to 1,000 characters each, in one voice or with a voice for each text (voices). Returns a link per clip and one ZIP with every clip, numbered in order (01-..., 02-...). Use it instead of calling text_to_speech many times. Needs a connected FreeTTS PRO account.

language.description: Language of the texts when no voice is given, like 'Spanish' or 'fr-FR'.

texts.description: The texts, one clip each, in the order wanted.

voice.description: A FreeTTS voice id from list_voices for every clip, like es-ES-ElviraNeural (a short name like 'Elvira' also works). If empty, a good voice for the language is chosen.

voices.description: A voice for each text, in the same order as texts, when the clips are spoken by different people: ["de-DE-KatjaNeural", "de-DE-ConradNeural", "de-DE-KatjaNeural"]. One entry per text; an empty entry uses voice.

name: batch_text_to_speech

clips.description: One entry per clip made, in order.

voice.description: The voice of this clip, when the call gave a voice per clip.

failed.description: Texts that could not be made, and why.

file.description: Every clip in one ZIP, numbered in order.

download_url.description: Where the file can be downloaded.

file_name.description: A name for the file, made from its first words.

title: Many short clips at once (FreeTTS)
